item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00122","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C01","C22","C15"],"selected_candidate_label":"C01","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C01 is a near-verbatim annual predecessor using the same one-sentence appointment formula, Puerto Rico judicial offices, acting-judge authority, paperwork authority, no-extra-compensation condition, disability contingencies, and year-specific duration. The child updates the justice and year and broadens the triggering contingencies to include vacancy and death. C22 and C15 are also strong members of the same recurring template, but C01 is the immediately preceding annual version and therefore the most plausible direct drafting source.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I hereby designate and authorize the Honorable A. Cecil Snyder, Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of Puerto Rico, to perform and discharge the duties of the office of Judge of the District Court of the United States for Puerto Rico","parent_excerpt":"I hereby designate and authorize the Honorable Luis Negron-Fernandez, Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of Puerto Rico, to perform and discharge the duties of Judge of the United States District Court for the District of Puerto Rico","explanation":"The same designation formula and judicial-office structure are reused with the named justice changed and minor title rephrasing."},{"child_excerpt":"and to sign all necessary papers and records as acting judge of the said district court, without extra compensation","parent_excerpt":"and to sign all necessary papers and records as Acting Judge of the said Court, without extra compensation","explanation":"This distinctive cluster of delegated authority and compensation language is nearly verbatim."},{"child_excerpt":"in case of vacancy in the office of judge of the said district court, or in case of the death, absence, illness, or other legal disability of the judge thereof, during the year 1952","parent_excerpt":"during the absence, illness, or other legal disability of the Judge thereof, during the year 1951","explanation":"The child retains the same contingency-and-annual-duration closing while adding vacancy and death and advancing the year."}]}
